products.name: Jamf AI Governance
products.note: Native AI control plane for macOS fleets, GA July 1, 2026; discovery and policy enforcement for on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints

profile_text.body:
Jamf, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, describes itself as a provider of Apple device management and security software. The company says its platform covers Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Vision Pro devices, from small deployments to tens of thousands of endpoints, and emphasizes same-day Apple OS support alongside integrations and an Apple IT community. Jamf states its purpose is to simplify work by helping organizations manage and secure an Apple experience, and positions itself as the only company offering a complete management and security solution for Apple-first enterprise environments. IDC MarketScape placed Jamf in the Leaders Category for Worldwide Unified Endpoint Management Software for Apple Devices in its 2025–2026 vendor assessment.

On the AI side, Jamf tracks a product called Jamf AI Governance, categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform. The company describes it as a native AI control plane for macOS fleets, covering discovery and policy enforcement for both on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints, with general availability set for July 1, 2026. The held facts show no litigation exposure or MCP server presence on record, and Jamf's Minnesota connection is noted across 116 associated data points in the site's registry.
